title: Electronics Engineer (Firmware)
jd:
Job Code: OPA-EEF-001 Electronics Engineer (Firmware) 
 
Overview / Role Summary 
This role is responsible for supporting the design and debugging of embedded firmware under the guidance of 
senior engineers, including C-based development, preparation of technical documentation and testing 
support. 
 
Key Responsibilities 
• Develop and debug embedded firmware 
• Interpret project documentation and implement firmware in C 
• Support firmware requirement implementation 
• Assist in test case documentation and design records 
• Maintain firmware revisions 
 
Required Skills & Qualifications 
• BE/B.Tech/ME/M.Tech in Electronics or related field 
• C programming skills in embedded systems 
• Understanding of digital and analog fundamentals 
• Ability to use DSOs and debug equipment 
 
Preferred / Desirable Qualifications 
• Bare-metal familiarity 
• Experience with Arm microcontrollers 
• Familiarity with UART, SPI, I2C, RS232/RS485 
• Awareness of ADC/DAC 
 
Experience Requirements 
• 0–3 years embedded firmware experience 
 
Technical Domains / Tools Expertise 
• Embedded C 
• Digital/Analog fundamentals 
• Standard embedded testing hardware
